text:
#!name=知乎网页净化
#!desc=毒奶特供 · 知乎网页 UA 替换 + 直读 · 来源 毒奶特供
#!author=limbopro

[MITM]
hostname = www.zhihu.com, zhuanlan.zhihu.com

[Rewrite]
https://www\.zhihu\.com/api/v4/questions/\d+/related-readings - reject
https://www\.zhihu\.com/api/v4/answers/\d+/related-readings - reject
https://www\.zhihu\.com/api/v4/hot_recommendation - reject
https://www\.zhihu\.com/commercial_api/banners_v3/mobile_banner - reject
https://zhuanlan\.zhihu\.com/api/articles/\d+/recommendation - reject

[Script]
http-response ^https://www\.zhihu\.com/question/, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/id77/QuantumultX/master/Script/zhihu.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https://zhuanlan\.zhihu\.com/p/, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/id77/QuantumultX/master/Script/zhihu.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
